name: UBRS: Blackrock Altar starts the Pyroguard Emberseer event for a Witch Hunter
contract: Using the Blackrock Altar in the Hall of Binding channels Emberseer Object Visual and then casts Emberseer Start, whose event releases the Blackhand Incarcerators so they can be attacked. Before the altar is used they cannot be attacked.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Upper Blackrock Spire
CONTROL: the Blackrock Altar is within reach
The altar starts the Emberseer Object Visual channel
The ritual completes and casts Emberseer Start
CONTRACT: a Blackhand Incarcerator can be attacked after the altar starts the event
